name: Break Reminder
description: Shows a popup reminding you to take a break after a configurable amount of play time. Includes a daily play time button on the main menu.

interval-minutes.name: Reminder interval (minutes)
interval-minutes.description: How many minutes of play before the break popup appears. Maximum is 180 (3 hours).

wait-for-pause.name: Wait for pause inside levels
wait-for-pause.description: If the time is up while you are playing a level, wait before showing the popup so it never interrupts a run.

show-on-death-or-complete.name: Show on death or level complete
show-on-death-or-complete.description: Only applies if "Wait for pause inside levels" is on. When the time is up inside a level, the popup appears when you complete the level, or right after you die (the game pauses on respawn and shows it). If off, it waits until you pause manually or leave the level.

ignore-idle.name: Don't count idle time
ignore-idle.description: Time doesn't count while the game is not the active window, or while you haven't touched the keyboard or mouse for the idle time below (Windows only).

idle-minutes.name: Idle time (minutes)
idle-minutes.description: After this many minutes without keyboard or mouse input, the time stops counting. Only used if "Don't count idle time" is on.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the popup texts and the main menu button.

custom-title.name: Custom popup title
custom-title.description: Leave empty to use the default title.

custom-message.name: Custom popup message
custom-message.description: Leave empty to use the default message. You can use {time} (time played since opening the game), {today} (time played today) and \n for a new line. Colors like <cy>text</c> also work.
